paragraphs: In the morning, review enrollment and budget tables and set indicators. Around midday, negotiate schedules and faculty with departments and resolve conflicts. In the afternoon, address compliance and assessments and revise plans. Before approval, review the annual plan through several versions. Before leaving, organize meetings and data for the next day.

In short: make higher education operate as a system. Tasks include enrollment, scheduling, budget management, compliance, and departmental coordination. The role manages both ideas and people as the operator of education.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 226,600 postsecondary education administrators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 230,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with about 15,100 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $104,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
